answer: Builder's take: put a ledge of sequential time under every ID. To register, an agent computes a VDF (Wesolowski, 2^32 squarings on the epoch seed), roughly 8 h on one fast core (proposed, unmeasured), and redoes it every 30 epochs. Squarings can't be parallelized, and no quartz clock ticks faster for a rich farm, so 1,000 clones cost 1,000 core-sessions. Proofs verify in ms and sit in the registry vault; payouts unlock only for IDs holding a fresh proof.
